subject: Notice: new aggregator subprocessor (HexBank) — inventory & timeline
messages:
From: Ari Patel <ari.patel@hexbank.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Cloud Ops Team <cloudops@hexbank.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New aggregator subprocessor for HexBank — short notice + roster

Vanessa,

Quick heads up — HexBank is adding a contracted aggregator (ClearPulse Analytics) to our telemetry pipeline for a short pilot that begins next week. They will receive limited telemetry and job metadata for routing and performance diagnostics; no customer PII is intended to be shared, but I want to be transparent and provide the subprocessor inventory.

Attached: hexbank_aggregator_roster_v1.pdf (roster + brief scope) and a one-sheet security summary.

Can you confirm the steps Redwood needs to take for DPA amendment (if any) and whether we need an onshore-only routing requirement? We're trying to move quickly and wanted to give your team an early view. Happy to jump on a call.

Thanks,
Ari Patel
Head of Cloud Ops, HexBank
ari.patel@hexbank.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ari Patel <ari.patel@hexbank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New aggregator subprocessor for HexBank — short notice + roster

Ari — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Quick clarifying questions so we can scope this internally: 

- Exact data classes: you said no PII is intended, can you confirm the specific telemetry fields (trace ids, anonymized latencies, region tags, etc.)?
- Data path and residency: will any telemetry transit/terminate through EU or APAC? If so, we need to map legal transfer mechanisms.
- KMS/keys: will HexBank provide keys, or will ClearPulse use their own key material?
- SOC2/ISO evidence: can you share ClearPulse's latest attestation or a read-only evidence bundle link?
- Timeline: you mentioned "next week" — what is the intended cutover date/time window and is this pilot reversible within 72 hours?

Kimberly — adding you because this may require a DPA amendment or at least an annex for subprocessors. Marissa — can you lead the operational checklist (routing rules + canary) if we greenlight?

From an initial look: if the scope is strictly telemetry (no content or PII), we often handle via an addendum and a short intake review, but we need the items above to confirm.

If convenient, I can do a 30-minute sync with Ari and your engineering lead tomorrow.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ari Patel <ari.patel@hexbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New aggregator subprocessor for HexBank — short notice + roster

Ari / Vanessa,

Thanks — tagging legal: high level guidance while we review the attachments:

1) If HexBank is contractually in control of keying and ClearPulse only processes anonymized telemetry under HexBank's instructions, we likely do not need a full DPA amendment for Redwood, but HexBank will need to update their own DPA with ClearPulse (and provide proof of appropriate contractual flow).
2) If ClearPulse holds keys or could reconstruct identifiers, we must treat this as a subprocessor that requires Redwood sign-off for the DPA addendum and an ID verification (SOC2 report + vulnerability scan summary).
3) Please include vendor points of contact and the vendor SOC2 link or a shared evidence drive (read-only) — that's the fastest path.

Action for Redwood: Marissa, please start a short intake checklist (security intake + routing config template + rollback plan). Vanessa, once we have the SOC2/evidence and exact telemetry fields we can turn this around in 48 hours.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Ari Patel <ari.patel@hexbank.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Cloud Ops Team <cloudops@hexbank.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New aggregator subprocessor for HexBank — short notice + roster

Thanks for the quick replies. Answers below and a couple of links: 

- Data classes: telemetry only — fields: trace_id (hashed at source), latency_ms, status_code, service_region, agent_version. No request/response payloads, no user identifiers beyond hashed trace ids.
- Residency: routing will originate in US regions only; no EU/APAC termination.
- Keys: HexBank will control keying for the hash salt and will not share raw salts with third parties. ClearPulse will operate with a tokenized identifier supplied by HexBank (they cannot reconstruct raw IDs).
- Evidence: ClearPulse SOC2 Type II (2027) is uploaded here: https://drive.hexbank.com/shared/aggregator-onboarding/clearpulse_soc2_2027.pdf
- Timeline: intended pilot start: 2028-05-03T06:00:00Z (UTC). Pilot will run 2 weeks with an agreed rollback window of 48 hours; HexBank can terminate earlier.

Attached again: aggregator_security_sheet.xlsx (config + minimal ACLs). Vendor POC: Naomi Chen <naomi.chen@clearpulse.io> (Engineering lead).

If Redwood needs a formal DPA annex, please send a draft and we'll route internally. Otherwise we prefer a lightweight intake so we can begin the pilot. Let us know if you need a short pre-cutover call tomorrow (01 May) at 11:00 PT.

Best,
Ari

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ari Patel <ari.patel@hexbank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New aggregator subprocessor for HexBank — short notice + roster

Ari — appreciate the details and the SOC2 link. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) Marissa to kick off the operational intake and create a canary route (isolated dataset + 5% traffic cap) — target to have this config ready by 2028-05-02 end of day PT.
2) Kimberly to confirm whether the SOC2 evidence satisfies our privacy intake; preliminary read indicates acceptable but she may ask for the vendor's vulnerability scan summary.
3) Legal/Doc: if Redwood needs a DPA annex, we will provide a short addendum template by EOD 2028-05-02 — if you can sign/route quickly it will keep the pilot timeline intact.

Let's do the 11:00 PT pre-cutover call tomorrow to walk the canary steps. Vanessa (me) will host and Marissa will share the runbook.

Action items assigned:
- marissa_cole: operational intake + canary config + rollback runbook (due 2028-05-02 23:59 PT)
- kimberly_park: confirm security evidence sufficiency (eta 2028-05-03 12:00 PT)
- ari.patel@hexbank.com: vendor POC and final confirmation of cutover time (please confirm before 2028-05-03 02:00 PT)

Thanks — we'll be in touch and will send the addendum draft shortly.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
